label: Window
text: The red planet fills almost the entire window. Canyons, dunes, endless red.

label: Fire extinguisher
text: An ordinary fire extinguisher. Sadly, it won't help against a lack of oxygen.

label: Wall compartment
text: You open the wall compartment. Inside lies a logbook.

label: Something on the floor
text: Below the window lies a small screwdriver with an odd tip.
done_text: This is where the screwdriver was.

label: Locker
done_text: The locker is open and empty.

label: Note on the bunk
text: A crumpled note pinned to the bunk. Someone sketched the power panel on it.

label: Wall panel
done_text: The compartment in the panel is open and empty.

label: Crew photo
text: The crew before launch, everyone laughing. On the back someone wrote: 'See you on the red planet!'

label: Porthole
text: The planet has come a little closer again.

label: Diary
text: 'Day 212: I can't stop staring at the planet. Only a few more hours and we'll finally walk on red sand.'

label: Coffee machine
text: The coffee machine says: 'PLEASE DESCALE.' Seriously, right now?

label: Knocked-over mug
text: A knocked-over coffee mug. Whoever was here left in a big hurry.

label: Glass tanks
text: Samples from the planet float in greenish liquid. The crew collected them from orbit.

label: Crack in the wall
text: This is where the meteorite tore the hull open. Emergency foam is only just holding it shut.

label: Wrenches
text: Two wrenches. Useless for the star-shaped screws on the generator.
